title: lowercase recipe name
description: short one-line description shown on listings
ingredients: or a plain string when structure isn't useful
directions: A plain string step, used when no specific ingredients need to be highlighted under it.

directions.step: An object step with ingredient indices, which renders those ingredients beneath this step.
Step refs can also override qty/unit. Cross-reference another recipe with [link text](recipes/slug-of-other-recipe).

notes: Optional tips. Markdown-style links to other recipes work here too: [pepper jam](recipes/pepper_jam).
